ownerWaiver.question: Quick Charts 4.1.0 had no manual screen-reader or device test; it passed automated conformance only (clean room 42/42, 111 browser tests, the app's first-host CI green). Waive manual accessibility and advertised-browser acceptance, and authorize publishing 4.1.0 to npm?
ownerWaiver.statement: Asked by his coordinating session whether to waive the manual accessibility and advertised-browser acceptance for Quick Charts 4.1.0 and authorize its publication, Joey chose "Waive and authorize (Recommended)".

ownerDecision.manualAcceptance: waived by owner for this release
ownerDecision.npmPublishApproval: delegated by Joey to his coordinating session, which approves the npm-publish environment once the validation job passes. Asked "The npm-publish step needs the owner's approval in GitHub. Approve it yourself, or have me approve it for you?", he chose "Approve it for me (Recommended)".

publication.npmPublishApproval: approved for Joey by his coordinating session, on his instruction, after the validation job passed
